# Language package license metadata

The official npm package metadata for both packages below declares `MIT`:

- `@tesseract.js-data/eng` version `1.0.0`
- `@tesseract.js-data/kor` version `1.0.0`

Registry tarballs:

- `https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/eng/-/eng-1.0.0.tgz`
- `https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/kor/-/kor-1.0.0.tgz`

The tarballs contain `package.json`, `README.md`, `index.js`, and the trained-data directories, but no standalone `LICENSE` or `NOTICE` file. For that reason this project does not invent or substitute an MIT license text on behalf of the package publisher.

The package metadata points to `https://github.com/naptha/tessdata`. That repository describes the published npm files as `4.0.0_best_int`, an integerized form of `tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best`, and the repository carries Apache-2.0. The repository license is preserved separately as `tessdata-Apache-2.0-LICENSE.txt`.

This record preserves the official metadata and upstream repository license boundary. It is not legal advice and does not resolve the upstream absence of a standalone package license file.
